set -euo pipefail

# Find and stop likely "system update" daemons (apt*, update*, unattended-upgrade, packagekit, dnf, yum, snapd, pacman, zypper, dpkg, fwupd).
# This script attempts graceful termination first, then force-kills remaining processes after a short wait.

PATTERN='(^|/)(apt|apt-get|aptitude|unattended-?upgrade|apt\.systemd\.daily|update(-|_)?manager|update(-|_)?notifier|packagekitd?|dnf-automatic|dnf|yum|fwupd|snapd|pacman|zypper|dpkg)([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)|(^|[[:space:]])update([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)|(^|[[:space:]])upgrade([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)'

echo "[info] Scanning for update-related processes..."
# Collect matching processes (PID and full command line)
mapfile -t matches < <(ps -eo pid=,args= | grep -Ei "$PATTERN" | grep -Ev "grep -E" || true)

if (( ${#matches[@]} == 0 )); then
  echo "[info] No matching update-related processes found."
  exit 0
fi

printf "[info] Found %d matching process(es):\n" "${#matches[@]}"
for line in "${matches[@]}"; do
  echo "  $line"
done

# Extract PIDs
pids=()
for line in "${matches[@]}"; do
  pid="${line%% *}"
  # Skip if PID is not a number for any reason
  [[ "$pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
  # Do not target our own shell/script
  if [[ "$pid" -ne "$$" ]] && [[ "$pid" -ne "$PPID" ]]; then
    pids+=("$pid")
  fi
done

if (( ${#pids[@]} == 0 )); then
  echo "[info] No actionable PIDs (after filtering)."
  exit 0
fi

echo "[info] Sending SIGTERM to: ${pids[*]}"
if ! kill -TERM "${pids[@]}" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[warn] Some processes may require elevated permissions. Consider re-running with sudo."
fi

# Wait up to 10 seconds for graceful exit
for i in {1..10}; do
  remain=()
  for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do
    if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
      remain+=("$pid")
    fi
  done
  if (( ${#remain[@]} == 0 )); then
    echo "[info] All targeted processes terminated gracefully."
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "[info] Waiting for processes to exit... (${#remain[@]} remaining)"; sleep 1
  pids=("${remain[@]}")
done

# Force kill any remaining
echo "[warn] Forcing termination (SIGKILL) for: ${pids[*]}"
if ! kill -KILL "${pids[@]}" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[error] Failed to SIGKILL some processes. You may need elevated permissions (try sudo)."
fi

echo "[info] Done.""}

set -euo pipefail

# Find and stop likely "system update" daemons (apt*, update*, unattended-upgrade, packagekit, dnf, yum, snapd, pacman, zypper, dpkg, fwupd).
# This script attempts graceful termination first, then force-kills remaining processes after a short wait.

PATTERN='(^|/)(apt|apt-get|aptitude|unattended-?upgrade|apt\.systemd\.daily|update(-|_)?manager|update(-|_)?notifier|packagekitd?|dnf-automatic|dnf|yum|fwupd|snapd|pacman|zypper|dpkg)([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)|(^|[[:space:]])update([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)|(^|[[:space:]])upgrade([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)'

echo "[info] Scanning for update-related processes..."
# Collect matching processes (PID and full command line)
mapfile -t matches < <(ps -eo pid=,args= | grep -Ei "$PATTERN" | grep -Ev "grep -E" || true)

if (( ${#matches[@]} == 0 )); then
  echo "[info] No matching update-related processes found."
  exit 0
fi

printf "[info] Found %d matching process(es):\n" "${#matches[@]}"
for line in "${matches[@]}"; do
  echo "  $line"
done

# Extract PIDs
pids=()
for line in "${matches[@]}"; do
  pid="${line%% *}"
  # Skip if PID is not a number for any reason
  [[ "$pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
  # Do not target our own shell/script
  if [[ "$pid" -ne "$$" ]] && [[ "$pid" -ne "$PPID" ]]; then
    pids+=("$pid")
  fi
done

if (( ${#pids[@]} == 0 )); then
  echo "[info] No actionable PIDs (after filtering)."
  exit 0
fi

echo "[info] Sending SIGTERM to: ${pids[*]}"
if ! kill -TERM "${pids[@]}" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[warn] Some processes may require elevated permissions. Consider re-running with sudo."
fi

# Wait up to 10 seconds for graceful exit
for i in {1..10}; do
  remain=()
  for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do
    if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
      remain+=("$pid")
    fi
  done
  if (( ${#remain[@]} == 0 )); then
    echo "[info] All targeted processes terminated gracefully."
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "[info] Waiting for processes to exit... (${#remain[@]} remaining)"; sleep 1
  pids=("${remain[@]}")
done

# Force kill any remaining
echo "[warn] Forcing termination (SIGKILL) for: ${pids[*]}"
if ! kill -KILL "${pids[@]}" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[error] Failed to SIGKILL some processes. You may need elevated permissions (try sudo)."
fi

echo "[info] Done.", "new_str": "#!/usr/bin/env bash
